messages.text:
BL-841 — EPIC — Bubble Control: the phone drives the swarm (start, drain-stop, emergency-stop, holiday quiet, shift) through the one control plane that already exists; do not promote directly; tracks children
Approval context: This is a NEW epic rather than a slice of BL-830 (Bubble remote screen pages), and that placement is the decision worth a look.
BL-830 explicitly puts "driving Control verbs from any page in this epic" out of scope: its pages are read-only projections. Control is the write path — it tears the swarm…
BL-841 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-841" (or "reject BL-841 <reason>") to act.
